Name: Presc's Multiplayer Greenhouse
Author: Presc
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/9mz5KbYG/about-the-mod.png[/img]
[b]Tired of splitting the greenhouse into tiny squares?[/b]

Stardew Valley multiplayer is fantastic, but the greenhouse was clearly built for 1 farmer. Sharing that single plot often means limiting your profits.
[b]Presc's Multiplayer Greenhouse solves this problem without breaking the game's vanilla feeling !
[/b]

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]4 Dedicated Crop Rooms: [/b]Instead of one shared plot, the greenhouse now features 4 separate annex rooms.
[*][b]Full Vanilla Size and feeling :[/b] Each annex room offers the standard 12x10 crop space. Every player gets the equivalent of a full vanilla greenhouse to themselves!
[*][b]New Central Hub[/b]: The main entrance has been transformed into a communal hub. It serves as a gathering point and includes space to plant fruit trees.
[/list]
[b]Why use this mod?[/b]
In a 4-player co-op, dividing the standard greenhouse leaves everyone with barely enough space to make Ancient Fruit wine profitable. With this mod, you can play together without holding each other back.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/MkvrhFCv/how-to-install.png[/img]
1. Download the mod
2. Open the zip file
3. Extract it to Stardew Valley/Mods.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Nd956dqr/warning.png[/img]
[b]Clear your greenhouse completely (crops, sprinklers, and furniture) before installing, or your items may be lost.
[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/8DMQcqCm/technical-stuff.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Requires latest version of [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]
[*]Requires latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]
[*]Works with the latest version of Stardew Valley (v1.6.15)
[*]Works with existing saves
[*]Works in both single-player and multiplayer (of course).
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Enhanced the Greenhouse Hub with expanded tree areas and functional sofas and minor decorative adjustments to all 4rooms.
